processContract.stdout: Successful JSON commands write exactly one JSON value to stdout unless an admitted explicit output-file flag writes that JSON value to the selected path and leaves stdout empty. processContract.stderr: Argument parsing, unsupported command, input admission, and output serialization failures write human diagnostics to stderr. Opt-in agent-envelope repair packets may write deterministic invalid-input JSON to stdout with exit code 1 and empty stderr.
